children: According to people familiar with the matter, Waymo plans to expand its fleet to 20,000 vehicles by the end of next year. According to Sina Finance, the Google parent Alphabet’s self-driving unit plans to use $5 billion raised earlier this month to increase its fleet fivefold to that level.

Waymo currently has 4,000 vehicles and plans to reach 8,000 by the end of this year, before expanding to 20,000 by the end of next year. Earlier this month, it secured a $5 billion loan from lenders including PIMCO, Blackstone and Sixth Street. The company said it would use the funds to expand its services across the United States and internationally.

Waymo currently operates in 15 U.S. cities and has announced plans to launch ride services in London, Tokyo, Singapore and Canada. Earlier this year, the company completed a $16 billion equity financing at a valuation of $126 billion.

title: Google Self-Driving Unit Waymo Reportedly Plans Fourfold Fleet Expansion to 20,000 by End of Next Year
